model.name: R19.30: Edit pen on a room item opens the canonical scenario unit for editing, not an empty per-user file.
model.description: BUG: the edit pencil icon on a room item navigates to data/users/<token>/... which is either empty or 'File not found', producing an empty editor. FIX: the edit pen MUST open the room's CANONICAL scenario unit (scenario/index/<shard>/<roomUuid>.scenario.json) in edit mode — the same target the working link icon resolves to. This aligns with R19.2.A (pencil opens room config/scenario editor) and R19.22 (per-user room.json is a symlink to the canonical unit).
model.tronQuote: > TRON: "edit pen runs into an empty file…bug."
model.crossRefNote: R19.2.A (pencil opens room editor) specifies the intent; R19.22 (per-user room.json is symlink to canonical unit) specifies the filesystem invariant. R19.30 is the bug: the edit pen currently resolves the per-user path (empty/missing) instead of following the symlink or pointing at the canonical unit directly.
